translations.desc_max_profit: 🏆 Max Profit: Cushion to 19,800 then sprint for 10k+ final win. Target ~29,000-32,000 daily.
translations.desc_fastest_clear: ⚡ Fastest: All-or-nothing max double-up every round. Only cashout at 20k+. Highest risk, fastest done.
translations.desc_balanced: ⚖️ Balanced: Build (3.2-6.4k cashouts) → Push (10k threshold) → Sprint. Reliable ~25,000.
translations.desc_aggressive_balanced: 💪 Aggressive: Like Balanced but pushes harder. Lower win-rate floors, bigger cashouts. Target ~28-30k.
translations.desc_adaptive_rush: 🔄 Adaptive: Starts all-in like Fastest, auto-downshifts to safe cushion if too many fails.
translations.desc_grinder: 🛡️ Grinder: Ultra-safe, never doubles more than 4x. Slow grind to 19,800 then one final sprint.
translations.desc_custom_parametric: ⚙️ Custom: Fine-tune your own win rate, cushion targets, and max doubles.
translations.log_cleanup_done: [System] Cleaned up {count} old log file(s) ({size_mb:.2f} MB freed).
translations.log_cleanup_none: [System] No old logs need cleanup based on current rules.
translations.opportunistic_double_msg: 🔥 Golden Card Override: Next card {rank} has {rate:.1%} win rate! Continuing double ({reward} <= {limit})!
translations.mod_fast_build_msg: ⚡ Fast Build Override: Headroom available ({reward} <= {cushion}). Continuing double!
translations.mod_drop_78_msg: 🛡️ 7/8 Bailout: Card {rank} is a 50/50 trap card. Cashing out {cashout} coins to protect bankroll!
translations.mod_drop_6789_msg: 🛡️ Middle Card Bailout: Card {rank} is in 6-9 danger zone. Cashing out {cashout} coins to protect bankroll!
translations.mod_drop_8_msg: 🛡️ Rank 8 Bailout: Card 8 has unfavorable odds (<50%). Cashing out {cashout} coins to protect bankroll!
translations.mod_free_roll_msg: 🎲 Small Hand Free-Roll: Initial payout {cashout} <= 200. Forcing double for high reward!
translations.mod_sprint_floor_msg: 🎯 Sprint Floor Override: Cashout {cashout} < 11,200. Pushing for 30k+ total coins!
translations.mod_mega_sprint_msg: 🚀 Mega Sprint Floor Override: Cashout {cashout} < 12,800. Pushing for 32k+ cap!
translations.tip_opp_a2: A & 2: ~94.1% win rate. Forces double up chance on A or 2 under daily limit (20k). Extremely safe, highly favorable odds.
translations.tip_opp_3k: 3 & K: ~86.3% win rate. Forces double up chance on 3 or K under daily limit (20k). Strong and favorable odds.
translations.tip_opp_4q: 4 & Q: ~78.4% win rate. Forces double up chance on 4 or Q under daily limit (20k). Solid and favorable odds.
translations.tip_opp_5j: 5 & J: ~70.6% win rate. Forces double up chance on 5 or J under daily limit (20k). Aggressive pace to build coins faster.
translations.tip_opp_610: 6 & 10: ~62.7% win rate. Forces double up chance on 6 or 10 under daily limit (20k). High risk for faster speed runs.
translations.tip_opp_79: 7 & 9: ~54.9% win rate. Forces double up chance on 7 or 9 under daily limit (20k). Near coin-flip for high-risk play.
translations.tip_opp_8: 8: ~47.1% win rate. Forces double up chance even on 8 under daily limit (20k). Unfavorable odds (ties lose); extreme risk.
translations.tip_mod_drop_78: Bailout 7 & 8: Early cashout during cushion phase (<19.8k) whenever dealt 7 or 8 to avoid 50/50 trap cards.
translations.tip_mod_drop_6789: Bailout 6/7/8/9: Early cashout during cushion phase (<19.8k) on any middle card (6, 7, 8, 9; ≤62.7%) for ultra-safe grinding.
translations.tip_mod_drop_8: Bailout 8 only: Early cashout during cushion phase (<19.8k) only on card 8 (unfavorable <50% odds), allowing 7 and 9 to continue.
translations.tip_mod_fast_build: Fast Build: Always doubles during cushion phase (<19.8k) as long as next payout fits within 19,800. Supersedes card overrides and bailouts.
translations.tip_mod_free_roll: Free-Roll: Always doubles round payouts ≤ 200 regardless of card, turning tiny payouts into high rewards.
translations.tip_mod_sprint_floor: Sprint Floor ≥ 11.2k: During sprint phase (≥19.8k), refuses cashout < 11,200 and forces doubling to guarantee ≥30,000 daily total.
translations.tip_mod_mega_sprint: Mega Sprint ≥ 12.8k: During sprint phase (≥19.8k), refuses cashout < 12,800 and forces doubling to push for 32,000+ daily cap.
translations.tip_btn_toggle_modifiers: Toggle Strategy Modifiers drawer (Card Overrides, Defensive Bailouts, Sprint Floors).
translations.tip_btn_config_strat: Configure custom strategy parameters (win rate threshold, cushion target, max doubles, etc.).
translations.tip_field_box_opacity: Adjust UI field box background opacity (0% transparent glass to 100% solid white).
translations.tip_debug_log: Enable detailed diagnostic logging to debug_log.txt for bot actions and recognition details.

error_translations.Settlement amount could not be confirmed: Settlement amount could not be confirmed reliably; stopped and excluded from ledger. Please check the settlement screen and daily balance.
error_translations.Challenge payout cannot be confirmed: Challenge payout cannot be confirmed; stopped. Will not use inaccurate or fallback payout to decide doubling. Please check the game screen.
error_translations.Currently mid-doubling: Currently mid-challenge; cannot recover round win count. Please restart from a fresh round.
error_translations.Missing doubling history: Missing doubling history for this round; cannot verify settlement. Please verify manually and start a new round.
error_translations.Initial payout for this round cannot res: Initial payout for this round cannot reserve cap room for Stage 3; please handle manually.
error_translations.Initial hand payout not yet confirmed: Initial hand payout not yet confirmed; cannot safely count wins. Please start from a fresh round.
